df = pd.read_excel('So_chi_tiet_ban_hang_1.xlsx', sheet_name='Sheet1', header=3)
df['date'] = pd.to_datetime(df['Ngày'], dayfirst=True)
df['thanh_tien'] = df['Thành tiền'].apply(parse_vn_number)

def revenue(period):
    sub = df[(df['date']>=period[0]) & (df['date']<=period[1])]
    keep = sub[sub['Trạng thái'].isin(['Đã hoàn thành','Đang giao'])]
    return keep['thanh_tien'].sum()

ask = revenue(('2025-08-01','2025-08-03'))
before = revenue(('2025-07-01','2025-07-03'))
print('ask (Aug 1-3):', ask)
print('before (Jul 1-3):', before)
pct = (ask - before)/before*100
print('pct:', pct)
print('increase?', ask>before)
